versions.subject: rule: suspicious renamed teamviewer
versions.detection:
dns_request:
    QueryName: 'taf.teamviewer.com'
filter:
    Image|contains: 'TeamViewer'
condition: dns_request and not filter

selection:
    QueryName:
        - 'taf.teamviewer.com'
        - 'udp.ping.teamviewer.com'
filter_main_teamviewer:
